title: Лесенка: день блогера и привычки подростка
description: Наступай на ступеньки, подсвечивая слова. Лесенка 1 — день блогера (снизу вверх), Лесенка 2 — день подростка (сверху вниз)

ladders.title: День блогера (снизу вверх)
steps: My day starts at 10 AM because I don't wake up early.
My day starts at 10 AM because I don't wake up early and my girlfriend makes breakfast.

After breakfast I check my emails and comments.
After breakfast I check my emails, my manager calls me and we discuss new projects.
At 5 PM I stream a new game and thousands of people watch me.
I love my job: I check emails, discuss projects, stream games and my fans send me funny messages.

ladders.title: Привычки подростка (сверху вниз)
steps: I study English because I want to travel, I read detective novels in bed and I dream of becoming a famous blogger.
